description: This file is a C header (.h) defining UTF-8 handling utilities, including functions for string width calculations, encoding detection, BOM handling, and string re-encoding. It also declares related constants, enums, and external references, primarily used within a larger codebase for UTF-8 and encoding support.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for a display mode string.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Calculates the width of a UTF-8 string, updating the start pointer and remainder.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a string with a specified length, possibly skipping ANSI sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if the provided text is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Determines if a given encoding name corresponds to UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE stream, with UTF-8 considerations.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the UTF-8 BOM in a text if present.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text to a string buffer with indentation and width constraints.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data to a string buffer with indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns UTF-8 text within a buffer based on specified alignment and width.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks for prohibited BOM usage in UTF-16/32 encodings.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Verifies if BOM is missing where it's required according to encoding.

methods.name: reencode_string_iconv
methods.description: Reencodes a string using iconv.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_len(const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a specified encoding with length considerations.

methods.name: char * reencode_string(const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a target encoding without length info.

methods.name: mbs_chrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a multibyte character in a given encoding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.git' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitmodules' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitignore' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitattributes' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.mailmap' after HFS case-folding.

ctags.name: reencode_string
ctags.signature: (const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)

ctags.name: reencode_string_len
ctags.pattern: /^static inline char *reencode_string_len(const char *a UNUSED, size_t b UNUSED,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
